name: Victor von Doom
summary: The announced central threat of Avengers: Doomsday. On screen, the MCU has shown almost nothing about him so far. Most of what fans 'know' comes from the comics, and this page keeps the two apart.

mcu.text: Robert Downey Jr. will play Victor von Doom in Avengers: Doomsday.
mcu.citation: Marvel Studios Hall H panel, San Diego Comic-Con, 27 July 2024

mcu.text: A hooded figure sits with baby Franklin Richards on Earth-828. A Doom mask is visible on screen; the face is not.
mcu.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — post-credits scene

mcu.text: The hooded figure in that scene is Doctor Doom.
mcu.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — post-credits scene
mcu.note: Strongly implied by the mask and by the Doomsday announcement, but the scene does not name him.

mcu.text: Doom tells the heroes they have "lived stolen lives" and must give them back.
mcu.citation: Final trailer, quoted by The Hollywood Reporter

mcu.text: "Hell answers to me, for I am Doom." He raises Sentinels against the Avengers and X-Men.
mcu.citation: Final trailer, as reported by Variety

mcu.text: His origin, home universe and full motive have not been established on screen.
mcu.note: Recorded as an absence: nothing on screen yet. Update after 18 December.

comics.text: First appeared in Fantastic Four #5 (1962), created by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby.
Monarch of the small European nation of Latveria. Diplomatic immunity is a recurring part of his character.
Reed Richards' college rival. A failed experiment that Doom blamed on Reed scarred him and drove him behind his iron mask.
A genius who combines advanced science with sorcery. His mother's pact with Mephisto drives many of his storylines.
In Secret Wars (2015), Doom salvages the remains of a dying multiverse after the incursions and rules the patchwork Battleworld as God Emperor Doom.
comics.citation: Secret Wars (2015), Jonathan Hickman & Esad Ribić

open.text: Doom has a specific interest in Franklin Richards.
open.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — post-credits scene
open.note: The staging of the scene points to it. His reason is unknown.

open.text: Doom wants to use Franklin's reality-altering power.
Downey's Doom is a variant of Tony Stark.
open.note: Popular because of the casting. Nothing on screen or in official material supports it yet.

open.text: Doomsday will adapt elements of the comics' incursion and Secret Wars story.
open.note: Avengers: Secret Wars is announced as the next Avengers film, but how closely either film follows the comics is unknown.

openQuestions: Which universe is this Doom from? Is he native to Earth-828?
Why is Doom with Franklin, and what does he want?
Why did Marvel cast Robert Downey Jr., and does the casting matter in-story?

name: Reed Richards
summary: The Fantastic Four's leader and, in the comics, Doom's defining rival. The MCU has shown two versions of him so far.

mcu.text: An Earth-838 variant played by John Krasinski appears briefly and is killed by Wanda.
mcu.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

mcu.text: Pedro Pascal plays the Earth-828 Reed Richards and is confirmed for Avengers: Doomsday.
mcu.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps; Doomsday cast livestream, 26 March 2025

comics.text: Doom and Reed met as college students. Their rivalry is one of Marvel's oldest.

name: Franklin Richards
summary: Reed and Sue's son. His power drew Galactus to Earth-828, and he is the child Doom is seen with.

mcu.text: Galactus wants Franklin because of his extraordinary power.
Seen with a hooded figure holding Doom's mask.
mcu.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — post-credits scene

comics.text: One of Marvel's most powerful reality-warping mutants. He has created entire pocket universes.

name: Loki
summary: No longer just a trickster: Loki is now the being who holds the multiverse's timelines together.

mcu.text: Sits at the End of Time and sustains the branching timelines.
Tom Hiddleston is confirmed in the Avengers: Doomsday cast.

open.text: Doom's plans will threaten or exploit the structure Loki maintains.

name: He Who Remains / Kang
summary: The MCU's original multiverse-saga villain. The thread was dropped, and it stays on the map so the history of the story is clear.

mcu.text: Killed by Sylvie, which triggers the multiverse.
A Council of Kangs is shown preparing for war.
mcu.citation: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania — mid-credits scene

superseded.note: Avengers: The Kang Dynasty was retitled Avengers: Doomsday, with Doom replacing Kang as the central villain.

name: Sam Wilson
summary: The current Captain America, set up as the person who will reassemble the Avengers.

mcu.text: Commits to rebuilding the Avengers.
Anthony Mackie is confirmed for Avengers: Doomsday.

name: The New Avengers
summary: Yelena Belova, Bucky Barnes, Red Guardian, John Walker, Ghost and Bob, rebranded by Valentina Allegra de Fontaine.

mcu.text: Publicly presented as "The New Avengers".
They are the first on Earth-616 to detect the arrival from another dimension.

name: Steve Rogers
summary: He put the shield down to live a life with Peggy. Doomsday brings him back.

mcu.text: Steve returns the Infinity Stones, then stays in the past to live his life with Peggy Carter.
Steve and Peggy have a son.
mcu.citation: Avengers Endgame: Encore, as reported by Variety
mcu.note: The son's name is not confirmed by Marvel.

mcu.text: The Fantastic Four arrive at the family's home and bring Steve back to lead the fight against Doom.
mcu.citation: Avengers: Doomsday final trailer, as reported by Variety

mcu.text: Steve summons Mjölnir.
mcu.citation: Final trailer, as described by Gulf News and others

mcu.text: Chris Evans returns as Steve Rogers, and Hayley Atwell as Peggy Carter.

open.text: Doom's "stolen lives" line is aimed at Steve's life with Peggy.
open.note: The line is in the trailer. Its target is not stated.

openQuestions: Did Steve's life with Peggy happen in the main timeline or in a branch?
What is their son's name, and what part does he play?

name: Thor
summary: One of the original six, back on the front line.

mcu.text: Last seen leaving with Love, the child he took in.
Chris Hemsworth returns as Thor.

name: Stephen Strange
summary: The MCU's incursion expert, and absent from Marvel's official Doomsday cast list.

mcu.text: Learns about incursions on Earth-838.
mcu.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

mcu.text: Clea tells him he caused an incursion and must help fix it.
He is not in Marvel's official Avengers: Doomsday cast list.

openQuestions: Is the incursion Clea warned about connected to Doomsday?

name: Wanda Maximoff
summary: She ripped through the multiverse. Her fate is unresolved, and she is absent from the official cast.

mcu.text: Pursues her children across the multiverse and kills Earth-838's Illuminati.
mcu.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

mcu.text: Brings Wundagore Mountain down on herself to destroy every copy of the Darkhold. Her fate is not shown.
mcu.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

mcu.text: She is not in Marvel's official Avengers: Doomsday cast list.

name: Scott Summers
summary: The X-Men's field leader, back from the 2000s films.

mcu.text: Leads the X-Men across the Fox films. He is killed in X-Men: The Last Stand, then restored in Days of Future Past's new timeline.
mcu.citation: X-Men (2000); X2 (2003); The Last Stand (2006); Days of Future Past (2014)
mcu.note: Fox film continuity, now part of the multiverse.

mcu.text: James Marsden returns as Cyclops.
Cyclops calls the X-Men together.
mcu.citation: Final trailer, as reported by Variety

openQuestions: Which point in the Fox timeline does this Scott come from?

name: Remy LeBeau
summary: A hero pulled from the Void, now fighting beside the X-Men.

mcu.text: Appears in the Void, one of the forgotten heroes who help Deadpool and Wolverine.
Channing Tatum returns as Gambit.
Fights alongside the X-Men.
mcu.citation: Final trailer, as reported by The Week

openQuestions: How did Gambit get from the Void to the X-Men?

name: Bucky Barnes
summary: Steve's oldest friend, now a congressman and one of the New Avengers.

mcu.text: Steve's best friend, turned into the Winter Soldier, then freed from that programming.
mcu.citation: Captain America: The Winter Soldier; Civil War

mcu.text: Now a US congressman, he joins the team that becomes the New Avengers.
Sebastian Stan returns as Bucky Barnes.

openQuestions: Will Bucky meet the Steve Rogers who left him behind in Endgame?

name: Bruce Banner
summary: He reversed the Snap. He is not in Marvel's official Doomsday cast list.

mcu.text: Wears the Nano Gauntlet to reverse the Snap, and is badly injured doing it.
Returns from Sakaar with his son, Skaar.
He is not in Marvel's official Avengers: Doomsday cast list.

openQuestions: A single press report says Endgame Encore shows Doom with Banner. This is unverified.
